zh-CN: 首次提供 macOS Apple Silicon 与 Intel 通用架构 Beta，包含桌面整理、归档及可选 CLI/MCP。
内置已校验的 7-Zip；视频抽帧需自行配置 FFmpeg，Mac 更新需要手动下载新版 DMG。
本 Beta 未经 Apple 公证；Mac 版禁用回收站相关源文件操作。
en-US: First universal macOS beta for Apple Silicon and Intel, with desktop organization, archiving, and optional CLI/MCP.
Includes verified 7-Zip; video frame extraction requires a separately configured FFmpeg, and Mac updates require a new DMG download.
This beta is not Apple-notarized; Trash-related source operations are disabled on Mac.
